plugins.cameraPermission: Switchboard scans a QR code shown by the desktop app to pair with a backend.

extra.//updates: OTA is INERT until someone with the EAS account runs `npx eas update:configure` from apps/mobile. That command writes `updates.url` here and `extra.eas.projectId`, which are account-specific and deliberately NOT invented by hand - a wrong projectId fails at build time with a confusing ownership error. Until then Updates.isEnabled is false and src/lib/otaUpdate.ts no-ops, while the APK lane (src/lib/selfUpdate.ts, GitHub Releases) works on its own. `runtimeVersion.policy: appVersion` above pins each OTA bundle to a matching native binary, so a JS bundle can never be served to an APK that lacks the native modules it needs. `android.permissions: [REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES]` is what lets the app hand a downloaded APK to Android's package installer.
extra.//: Google OAuth client for the direct accounts.google.com PKCE flow (src/lib/google-auth.ts). Real values live in Secret Manager secret 'switchboard-oauth-client' in GCP project teejayproject: gcloud --configuration=personal secrets versions access latest --secret=switchboard-oauth-client. NEVER commit real values here. The stored client is Desktop-type, which works for the loopback probe but is REJECTED for custom-scheme redirects on device: shipping needs an Android-type client (package app.switchboard.mobile + signing SHA-1) and an iOS-type client. Those have no secret, so googleClientSecret stays empty for device builds.
